data_notes: This feature (dashboard leave-balance breakdown and empty state) is frontend-only and introduces no persistence layer. It touches only web/src/ (DashboardPage, its test, and shared types if needed). The data is already fetched via balanceService.getBalances() from the existing GET /balances/me endpoint; LeaveBalanceView already carries entitledDays, usedDays, pendingDays, and available. No new tables, repository interfaces, or concrete implementations are required — the backend PostgreSQL schema and repositories are unchanged. The existing backend tables (employees, leave_types, leave_policies, leave_balances, leave_requests, audit_logs, notifications) are reused as-is.
transaction_contract: Read-only feature: no multi-step writes. No transaction contract required.
